h2: Your systems moved the data. Did they preserve its meaning?

What does your data need to get right?

paragraphs: ShipDataFast helps engineering teams build data flows, validate critical datasets and reconcile differences between systems.
A particular focus on financial services. Built for data problems across industries.
Conceptual model under exact match rules. Real runs vary by configuration.
Data flows fail in subtle ways. Pipelines execute without errors, but values shift, timing cut-offs misalign, and critical records drop silently between source and target.

We work with teams facing three practical challenges: migration results that don't match source systems, transformed figures that require rigorous validation checks, and manual spreadsheet reconciliations that cannot scale reliably.
Practical architecture and implementation connecting sources, building robust transformation pipelines, and establishing traceable handovers.
Define clear data requirements and implement repeatable automated checks for schemas, required fields, value bounds and business consistency.
Establish exact matching contracts across decoupled systems. Identify missing records, numeric differences and conversion mismatches.
Specialised tools designed to address distinct data integrity challenges.
Compares corresponding records across two separate datasets (source and target) under explicit matching and tolerance rules.
Evaluates a single dataset against defined criteria such as presence, uniqueness, format patterns and numeric ranges.
We believe in deterministic, verifiable data operations. Whether in consulting delivery or software execution, every difference must trace directly to explicit inputs and matching policies.
Our engagements deliver repeatable verification workflows rather than opaque black-box dashboards.
ShipDataFast is an independent engineering consultancy founded by Ivano Mannella, focused on reliable data architecture and pipeline integrity.

We have deep technical experience in financial services and fintech integrations—where precision, audit trails, and cut-off reconciliation are mandatory—while applying the same rigor to complex data problems across industries.
Tell us which systems are involved, what is going wrong and when you need an answer. A short description is enough to start a technical conversation.
